ProjectVOAT - Structure, Money Flow & Getting Involved

As noted above 40% of the total revenue earned by ProjectVoat will be set aside to reward those that have contributed in some way. How this revenue is divided is a bit complex but I'll do my best to explain.

Contributors to this project will share this revenue in some way, either for a set length of time or for the life of the project depending on the type of contribution.

Revenue set aside for contributors will go into a pool. Contributors will be paid from this pool as funds arrive and the amount determined by the type of contribution and / or level of involvement during the time the money was earned.

For those that take part in our initial fund-raising you will share in this pool for the life of this project as outlined in the specific fund-raiser.

For those that provide a needed service, such as programming, the share and duration of your interest will be negotiated with you on a case by case basis.

For those that work on this project specifically, a project manager for instance, your share of interest will be based on the scope of your contribution and will continue as long as you are actively participating.

Revenue will be shared between all contributors that were involved during the time it was earned.

All revenue will be distributed even if there is only a single contributor involved.

This will allow us to reward early contributors with a larger share of revenue and take on new contributors only when the size, scope and revenue of ProjectVOAT will sufficiently support it.

A Quick Example:

A week into this project 3 people have purchased a fund-raising item, 1 is overseeing a sub project to bring in new members and 6 are actively working on that sub project as ambassadors.

For the ease of discussion we will assume that all 10 contributors were determined to be equal. Also assume that the amount of revenue added to the pool is $100 per week.

Using those assumptions each contributor would receive $10 per week. If 2 of the "ambassadors" quit participating then the amount would be shared with the remaining 8 making it $12.50 per week. The same is true in reverse if new contributors are added.

The purpose of this distribution system is to reward early contributors that helped ProjectVOAT get started and to allow us to bring in new contributors as the size, scope and revenue from the project grows.

In this example all contributors were assumed to be equal. In practice this will vary based on level of contribution in comparison with others involved in the project. Also, in this example "ambassadors" were counted as contributors only so long as they participated. In practice this will be determined on a case by case basis. For instance, someone contributing code that manages the entire operation would be considered a contributor for the life of the project, even if he or she made no further contributions.
